rules: campaign: strong evidence or a pair score ≥ 0.15; page-kit features and the ad-library payer (similar_dom, comment, asset, hidden_fields, page_template, favicon, endpoint, param_schema, comment_block, ad_payer, scam_brand, tracker_host, adsense_publisher, template_phrase, advertiser_name, kit_string, company_id, bank_account, postal_address, overlay_template, reused_footage, hosting_account, lead_flow, affiliate_team, mx) count together as one kind and do not link alone, with each other or with content: at least one kind of evidence from outside the page kit and content is needed; discounted evidence does not count

content (similar_text, similar_image, similar_image_semantic, similar_audio, similar_voice, imagehash): without infrastructure on both sides, a campaign needs at least 2 different kinds of content; when any ad has infrastructure, content is one kind of evidence and does not link alone; the same creative file (SHA-256, or CLIP frames ≥ 0.97 with the same audio) links alone

creative variant: a campaign without infrastructure, linked only by content, joins the only campaign with infrastructure whose creatives it nearly repeats (the same dHash or file, dHash within distance ≤ 6, CLIP ≥ 0.95); a creative close to several campaigns joins none, a variant does not merge campaigns, text alone does not join
similar-campaign group only: technique, persona, profit_claim
different accounts of the same page-builder platform do not join into a campaign without strong evidence; strong evidence of kind path_id alone is not enough either
group of similar campaigns: remaining links between campaigns with a score (without discounted evidence) ≥ 0.3
